rule: Any dependency shared by both lanes that can bias family labels, targets, numerical rules, or interpretation must be registered and independently verified before packet APQ.

entries.verification: analytic family certificate plus independent generator/provenance validation
analytic alias certificate and explicit adversarial alias controls

entries.dependency: matrix exponential and finite-time target reference calculations
entries.verification: separately implemented reference calculation or analytic certificate for frozen cases
analytic identity certificate plus independent numerical reference check

entries.dependency: profile implementation and physical-coordinate profile construction
entries.verification: source identity plus independent mechanical reproduction tests
final lock/container identity plus independent reference tests for critical calculations

failure_rule: If a required shared truth premise cannot be independently verified, exact packet APQ remains blocked and the affected claim returns NEED_MORE_INFO or frozen-contract refusal according to stage.
